config.scope: SOURCE DEVELOPMENT E01/E02/E03; A03/A07/A12 only; articulation only, no absolute hip-root position or E04
config.reference_budget: 2people x3actions x10pairs x2poses=120poses;60lag8increments; same reference set for all calibrated controls
config.recurrence: state=anchor+rho*(previous_state-anchor)+gain*(predicted_delta-bias). New record or missing8frame step resets to anchor. First frame has unknown state, not a hidden reference pose.
config.calibration: Anchor interpolates source mean and120reference mean. Bias is mean prediction-minus-true increment over60reference pairs, with source-validation-selected shrinkage.
config.selection: Minimum pooled source-validation articulation NJE; query people4/9 disjoint from reference TRAINpeople1/2. All parameters frozen before held-room query scoring. First grid tie.
config.limitations: Prior-anchored articulation; no GT previous pose, query mean, action identity or future CSI supplied to recurrence. Development rotations reuse source rooms. Not final or new-room efficacy proof.
config.reference_selection_limit: Source validation reference people are in the frozen decoder's training set; target reference people are unseen by that decoder. Source calibration residuals can therefore be optimistic.
